description: Suitree is an architectural treehouse retreat set 9 meters above the forest floor in Guanacaste, where light, elevated suites blend into the jungle canopy. Guests enjoy panoramic mountain views, deep nature immersion, and a refined slow-food dining experience in total seclusion.
hero_description: Sleep above the forest in a private treehouse suite immersed in the Guanacaste canopy.
local_insight: Ideal for couples and design-minded travelers who want privacy, silence, and a genuine connection with nature rather than a busy beach resort. The elevated suites and slow-food dining make it a memorable honeymoon or wellness escape.

faq.a: Suitree is located in Sardinal, Guanacaste, Costa Rica, reached in roughly 30-45 minutes from Guanacaste Airport (LIR) in Liberia.

faq.q: What types of accommodations does Suitree offer?
faq.a: Suitree offers elevated treetop suites, including options with private pools, Jacuzzis and pool views, along with garden-view bungalows.
The on-site Taru restaurant serves a slow-food experience with seasonal menus built around local ingredients in an intimate forest-and-sky setting.

amenities: Treetop suites elevated in the forest canopy
Swim-up pool and Suitree Stone Pool
Guided nature, wildlife and cultural tours
